author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Spooky Tales, a retro horror anthology game developed by Liminal Road. Hosted by a macabre, undead master of ceremonies with a seriously twisted sense of humor, players will dive into distinct stories that pay homage to classic horror tropes. These stories include everything from bloody 80s slashers and eerie Japanese body horror to modern mascot horror and vintage pulp terror. Spooky Tales is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Spooky Tales - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 launch trailer for Smalland: Survive the Wilds, an open-world crafting survival game developed by Merge Games. Players will embark on a massive adventure in a small yet vast and hazardous world. Craft powerful armor sets to personalize the appearance, grant resistance from the elements, abilities, and more. Uncover ancient lore scattered throughout a multitude of diverse biomes as players learn to survive, battling the hostile wilderness and elements themselves. Smalland: Survive the Wilds is available now for Nintendo Switch 2 alongside PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Smalland: Survive the Wilds - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the announcement trailer for Subject 404, a psychological horror game developed by BESK Entertainment. This psychological horror game is built around one rule: obey the panel. Each room gives the player a short-timed command through a cold mechanical panel. Some are simple, some are stressful, and some feel wrong. If the player fails or disobeys, the executioner comes for them. Subject 404 is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Subject 404 - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the The Mandalorian and Grogu Watch Party trailer within Fortnite. On May 19 at 10am ET, you’re invited to The Mandalorian and Grogu Watch Party Island to see a special message from Jon Favreau and get a 10-minute sneak peek of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu ahead of the theatrical release on May 22.
title: Fortnite x The Mandalorian and Grogu - Official Watch Party Island Trailer
